name: landScape
source:
"...That day, I had an encounter with fate."

The protagonist "Akamine Ichiya" transfers from Tokyo to Habara Middle School, where he meets Koori Chikage and gradually gets closer to her. Before long, he unveils various secrets surrounding Chikage...

[Translated from the [url=https://return-0.booth.pm/items/717252?registration=1]official site[/url]]
